text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Steady progress, day by day. Step by 
gradual step, synchronization with Neo 
Universe proceeds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm gradually beginning to understand the 
meaning behind the signals she sends out 
during training.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trai... ner... I can't run anymore... 
"Hypergolic propellant" compromised...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Propellant, meaning... fuel. If my legs 
won't move, then instead of 
muscle-building nutrients...
choice_data_list: Let's drink a fast-acting energy drink.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's an "emergency." The drive 
unit's "silica glass" is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The drive mechanism, which means... the 
joints. If the heat-resistant material 
there is heating up...
choice_data_list: Then let's ice it right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between mild cases and severe cases, I've 
come to understand the difference pretty 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as my understanding deepened, what 
became even clearer was...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe recommends. A 
transition from cooling to heating."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
We have passed the "gravitational 
sphere"... Any further cooling will lead 
to solidification.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems there's no need to cool it down 
any further. Rather than applying heat, or 
warming it up...
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's switch to heat therapy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What became crystal clear was her 
"brilliance." Her words were cryptic, but 
her analysis was always spot on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her intelligence is truly terrifyingly 
high. However... something was a bit 
strange.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zero, one... Zero, one...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san? Um... What kind of exercise are 
you doing?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That looks like a rather unusual move... 
What kind of effect does that stretch 
have...?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe will perform "attitude 
control."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The habit of leaning backward... is 
"DEDU." In other words, "drastically" 
needed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My times haven't improved much lately. 
When they mentioned 'leaning back', it 
clicked. It's my center of gravity...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, why was Neo Universe able to notice 
such a deep reason that even I, her 
Trainer, couldn't decipher?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I see! As expected of you, Uni-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best not to lose to Uni-san 
either! My Make Debut is coming up soon, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Make Debut... It is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Uni-san? What do you mean, 
negative...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――I have "concerns." The launch will take 
time...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Especially the initial launch. Zenno Rob 
Roy, you—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I might get "excluded," you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ex... clusion...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Excuse me, what do you mean "can't 
race"?

text_block_list.name: URA Clerk
text_block_list.text:
There were a lot of entries for this race, 
you see. And as luck would have it, you 
were eliminated in the lottery.

text_block_list.name: URA Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry about this, but could you 
submit an application again?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No way... Even though I worked so hard 
preparing for the Make a Debut...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Starting over from scratch again with this 
body...

text_block_list.name: URA Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that she's rushing her debut 
even though she's still developing? If 
that's the case..."

text_block_list.name: URA Clerk
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't panic too much. Things often 
don't go according to plan in the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I want to catch up to Uni-san as 
soon as possible, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, Neo Universe also— 
recommends "no rushing"... The overstrain 
was visible...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is……"worried." Even without 
rushing, in the future you'll land near 
"Fra Mauro."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe had noticed that Zenno Rob 
Roy was pushing herself too hard. Perhaps 
because they often trained together. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were also things that could never 
have been noticed. Namely—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I might get "excluded," you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ex... clusion...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"Entry Denied." How did they foresee that 
we'd lose the lottery due to the sheer 
number of applicants?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps she had already grasped the 
Umamusumes' movements. However...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list:
How did you know I wouldn't be able to 
race?

How did you know I wouldn't be able to 
run?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san...? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I'm... fine... Just a little bit. A 
"migraine"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many things I've come to 
understand. Yet at the same time, the 
mysteries I cannot comprehend continue to 
grow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying a small paradox, my days with Neo 
Universe continued.
